Our story

A California family business, not a call center

Sunset Bail Bonds is a family owned and family operated business. We were born and raised here in California and have lived in both Orange County and Los Angeles County. These days we have bail agents living throughout the state, near most local jails, ready to help bail you out.

Knowing our way around Southern California and understanding how each particular jail works is what makes a bail process fast instead of slow. We have been writing bail in California since 1993, and we are glad to answer any question you have and to contact the jail on your behalf.

While other companies claim to write bail bonds across the entire United States, we concentrate on Southern California — and more specifically on Los Angeles and the OC.

Why families choose us

Bail should not be difficult

You should feel comfortable with the bail bond company you choose. We have helped many families bail out a loved one after another company pushed them away. These are the reasons they came to us.

What they told us

“The agent on the phone was mean and impatient.”

How we work

The bail agent on the phone should be kind, helpful and have plenty of time to speak with you. Too many companies hire unskilled and unlicensed people to answer their phones. You deserve better than that.

What they told us

“They asked for my house or my car as collateral.”

How we work

In many cases you do not need collateral at all. Good people in our community are arrested every day — one DUI or one argument that got out of hand does not make someone a flight risk. We listen first and ask for collateral only when it is genuinely necessary.

What they told us

“They said another company would come post the bond.”

How we work

The company you call should be the company you meet at the jail, and the same people should answer every time you call. With us they do — you speak to the owner, and in many cases the person who answers the phone is the person who meets you at the jail.

Contact Sunset Bail Bonds and see the difference. You will speak to the owner every single time you call.
